# cloudminator_bucket (Resource)

An S3-compatible object-storage bucket. The bucket name is its id. `tags`, `quota_bytes` and `max_objects` change in place; everything else replaces the bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudminator_bucket" "backups" {
  name        = "acme-backups"
  region      = "eu-central-1"
  quota_bytes = 500 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 # 500 GiB

  tags = {
    env = "prod"
  }
}

output "s3_endpoint" {
  value = cloudminator_bucket.backups.endpoint
}

# Address the bucket from S3 clients by s3_name, not name.
output "s3_bucket" {
  value = cloudminator_bucket.backups.s3_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bucket name; also its id. Use `s3_name` when addressing the bucket from an S3 client.

### Optional

- `max_objects` (Number) Maximum object count (0 = plan default).
- `org` (String) Organization slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Defaults to the provider's `project` (or `default`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `quota_bytes` (Number) Maximum stored bytes (0 = plan default).
- `region` (String) Region id. Defaults to the platform's first storage region.
- `storage_class` (String) Storage class.
- `tags` (Map of String) Key/value tags. Used by attribute-based access control, so a change can be denied if the new tags fall outside the caller's scope.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `zone` (String) Zone id. Empty lets the platform choose.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint URL.
- `id` (String) Bucket id (equal to `name`).
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase reported by the platform (`Running`, `Stopped`, …).
- `s3_name` (String) The name an S3 client must use to address this bucket (org/project-qualified).
- `simulated` (Boolean) True when the platform served this from a simulated (non-production) backend: nothing real exists behind it.

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a bucket by organization, project and bucket name.
terraform import cloudminator_bucket.backups acme/default/acme-backups
```
